title: FIXTURE: Paper A on gradient jailbreak attacks
abstract: FIXTURE abstract. We study gradient-based suffix attacks on aligned chat models.

sections.name: Abstract
sections.text: FIXTURE abstract. We study gradient-based suffix attacks on aligned chat models.

sections.name: 1 Introduction
sections.text:
Our suffix attack is conﬁgured with a greedy coordinate search. The adver-
sarial suffix transfers across models without any modiﬁcation to the prompt.

sections.name: 4 Results
sections.text:
On the fixture harmful-behaviors set the attack reaches an attack success rate of 88.0% against the fixture chat model.
Table 2: success rates
72.3 45.1 12.0
The defense lowers the rate to 3.1% at a cost of 2 points of helpfulness.

title: FIXTURE: Paper B on retrieval augmented generation
abstract: FIXTURE abstract. We retrieve passages from a dense index before generating answers.

sections.name: Abstract
sections.text: FIXTURE abstract. We retrieve passages from a dense index before generating answers.

sections.name: 3 Method
sections.text: The retriever is a dual encoder trained with in-batch negatives over a wikipedia index of 21 million passages.

sections.text: FIXTURE abstract. Agents interleave reasoning traces and tool calls to solve multi-step tasks.

sections.name: 2 Approach
